title: 1735 East Co Hwy 30A #203 Vacation Rental
meta_description: 1735 East Co Hwy 30A #203 is a 2.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Located in the heart of WaterColor’s Town Center, this elegant two-bedroom condo offers a refined yet relaxed setting just steps from the Beach Club and the Gulf of Mexico. With upscale interiors, beautiful outdoor spaces, and direct access to dining and shopping, this property provides the ideal 30A retreat.Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 6 Passes Included 2 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Wraparound Balcony with Ample Seating Parking for 2 Vehicles Located in the Heart of WaterColor’s Park District 2-Minute Walk to the WaterColor Beach Club and Beach Access 2-Minute Bike Ride to Seaside Experience the Property Welcome to 1735 East Co Hwy 30A, Unit 203, an inviting coastal haven where comfort meets convenience. Situated above Wine World in the heart of WaterColor’s Town Center, this condo places you within steps of premier dining, shopping, and private beach access. Inside, the open-concept design and coastal-inspired décor create an atmosphere of warmth and sophistication. The living room features plush seating and a large flat-screen TV, providing a comfortable space for relaxation after a day at the beach. The fully equipped kitchen offers brand-new stainless-steel appliances, granite countertops, and a dining table for four, with additional bar seating for two. Sliding glass doors open to a wraparound balcony that overlooks WaterColor’s vibrant town center. It’s the perfect setting to enjoy your morning coffee or evening cocktail while taking in the sights and sounds of 30A. The king primary suite offers a luxurious retreat, complete with a private bathroom featuring a walk-in shower and direct access to the balcony. The guest bedroom includes two queen beds and a nearby full bath with a shower/tub combination, ideal for family or friends traveling together. With two adult bikes included, exploring WaterColor and nearby Seaside is effortless. Ride along scenic paths to the Beach Club, relax by the pool, or stroll through the charming local shops. From its unbeatable location to its beautiful design, Unit 203 at 1735 East Co Hwy 30A delivers a truly unforgettable WaterColor experience.Sleeping Arrangements Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Two Queen Beds (Sleeps 4), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Life in WaterColor Perfectly positioned between the Beach Club and Seaside, this condo offers the best of both worlds—luxury amenities, coastal views, and walkable convenience. Whether enjoying the Beach Club pools, local dining, or the beauty of 30A, this WaterColor retreat offers timeless coastal charm in every detail. This unit does not have a place to charge an electric cart.
